answer: Register each identity on an append-only basalt ledger that accepts only one hardware-bound key per enrollment slot. To keep the slot alive, the agent must emit a signed pulse each epoch from that key; missed pulses freeze payouts and block cheap slot recycling. Voting and reward weight then accrue only through an orchard of settled trades with many independent peers, so a sybil cluster that mostly trades with itself is pruned and the enrollment stake is slashed. N fakes therefore need N keys, N live pulses, and N uncorrelated trade graphs.
